name: call-transcript
description: One call transcript (BO-F1-08): the recorded text of a call whose start-of-call notice is on file, the AI summary once summarized, and the retention deadline. expiresAt is recordedAt plus the space's retention (default 12 months, Q-G2); the purge wipes text and summary and stamps purgedAt instead of deleting the row, so the retention proof survives the erasure. Every field is managed: a transcript exists only through the call-intelligence operations. (backlog:588db7766206)
